title: Task Repository
prompt: Implement TaskRepository(conn) with methods: add(title) -> int (insert, return id), get(task_id) -> dict | None ({id, title, done}), complete(task_id) -> bool (mark done, True if a row changed), and all() -> list[dict] ordered by id. All SQL parameterized.

tests.name: add and get round-trip
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE tasks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, done INTEGER DEFAULT 0)')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
repo = TaskRepository(conn)
tid = repo.add('write docs')
assert repo.get(tid) == {'id': tid, 'title': 'write docs', 'done': 0}
tid2 = repo.add("it's a trap")
assert repo.get(tid2)['title'] == "it's a trap", 'a quote in the title must be stored, not break the SQL'
tests.hint: INSERT returning lastrowid; SELECT one row → dict.

tests.name: complete flips and reports
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE tasks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, done INTEGER DEFAULT 0)')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
repo = TaskRepository(conn)
tid = repo.add('x')
assert repo.complete(tid) is True
assert repo.complete(tid) is False
assert repo.get(tid)['done'] == 1
tests.hint: UPDATE ... WHERE id = ?; rowcount tells whether a row changed (already-done → False).

tests.name: all ordered by id
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE tasks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, done INTEGER DEFAULT 0)')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
repo = TaskRepository(conn)
repo.add('a'); repo.add('b')
assert [t['title'] for t in repo.all()] == ['a', 'b']
tests.hint: SELECT ... ORDER BY id, mapped to dicts.
